scores.label: A
scores.note: 4 'Research findings suggest' hedges the original 'have shown'; 5 adds 'Extensive' and weakens the causal claim to 'a correlation'; 1 drops 'can' (enhances); 2 'is associated with' softens causation; 3 is wordy ('in the realms of')

scores.label: B
scores.note: 1 adds boosters 'consistently' and 'significantly'; 2 adds 'Numerous', turns the claim into a correlation and drops memory and focus; 3 adds 'Multiple empirical' and 'corroborated the efficacy', overstating; 5 adds 'Numerous' and 'effective means', raising certainty; 4 is redundant ('evidence-based research') and softens to 'associated'

scores.label: C
scores.note: 2 'Investigations suggest' hedges the original 'have shown'; 3 'may' slightly weakens 'can'; 4 is clunky ('regarding memory'); 5 adds 'sustained'
